Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Scroll of Sealing reveals and reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 10 for 4 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, this talent's Armor reduction effect is increased to 15 and its duration to 6 seconds.

level1.name: Field Study
level1.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

level1.name: Sapphire
level1.description:
Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and its slow by 30%.

Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

level4.name: Potion of Shielding
level4.description: Whenever an ally is healed by a Healing Potion, they gain a 140~~0.04~~ Shield for 6 seconds.

level4.name: Rejuvenation Potion
level4.description: Healing Potions restore 15 Mana and heal for an additional 114~~0.04~~ over 3 seconds.

level4.name: Ruby
level4.description:
Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100%  and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250~~0.04~~ when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds.

Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

level7.name: Cube Mastery
level7.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Scroll of Sealing from 40 to 25. Each enemy Hero hit by Horadric Cube reduces the cooldown of Scroll of Sealing by 4 seconds.

level7.name: Kanai's Cube
level7.description: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Emerald
level7.description:
Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100% and have it reduce the healing received of enemy Heroes by 75% for 4 seconds.

Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

level10.name: Stay Awhile and Listen
level10.description:
After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.

Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

level10.name: Lorenado
level10.description:
Vector Targeting
After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20~~0.04~~ damage to Heroes hit.

level13.name: Super Healing Potion
level13.description:
If a Healing Potion isn't picked up for at least 2 seconds, it heals for 100% more.

Passive: Healing Potion heals for 25% more when the target is under 50% health.

level13.name: Potion of Revival
level13.description: When a Healing Potion is picked up, it also heals all nearby allied Heroes for 75% of the healing amount.

level13.name: Ancient Blessings
level13.description: Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62~~0.04~~ damage in an area and heal for 90~~0.04~~ for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

level16.name: Scroll of Stone Curse
level16.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

level16.name: Safety in Numbers
level16.description: If at least 2 allied Heroes are nearby, Fortitude of the Faithful grants an additional 10 Armor, 50% Mana Regeneration per second, and causes Deckard's Basic Abilities to recharge an additional 50% faster.

level16.name: Horadric Staff
level16.description: Every 5 seconds, Deckard's next Basic Attack Stuns Heroes for 0.75 seconds.

level20.name: Respect the Elderly
level20.description: Stay Awhile and Listen Silences and Blinds enemies for 3 seconds upon waking up from Sleep.

level20.name: Morenados!
level20.description: Lorenado gains an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds every time an enemy Hero is knocked back. This effect can only occur once per 0.5 seconds.

level20.name: Bottomless Flask
level20.description: After use, Healing Potions recharge after 8 seconds.

level20.name: Perfect Gems
level20.description: Reduce the cooldown of all Gems to 5 seconds and the cooldown of Horadric Cube by 6 seconds.

basic.name: Drag
basic.description:
Dehaka lashes out his tongue, dealing 160~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit, Stunning and dragging them with him for 1.75 seconds.

If Dehaka is Stunned or Silenced while using Drag, the effect ends.

basic.name: Dark Swarm
basic.description: Deal 48~~0.04~~ damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies for 3.5 seconds. While active, you are able to move through units. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

basic.name: Burrow
basic.description: Burrow into the ground, entering Stasis and becoming Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While Burrowed, Dehaka can move at 50% movement speed.

heroic.name: Isolation
heroic.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200~~0.04~~ damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

heroic.name: Adaptation
heroic.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

trait.name: Essence Collection
trait.description:
Heal Dehaka for 29~~0.04~~ Health per stored Essence over 5 seconds. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

Passive: Gain 10 Essence from Takedowns and 2 Essence from nearby Minions dying. Maximum of 50 Essence.

mount.name: Brushstalker
mount.description:
Activate to burrow to a bush on the Battleground.

Passive: Gain 20% movement speed while in a bush and for 2 seconds after leaving. 

Passive: Gathering a Regeneration Globe reduces the cooldown of Brushstalker by 40 seconds.

level1.name: Enduring Swarm
level1.description: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

level1.name: Tissue Regeneration

Regeneration Globes grant 10 Essence.

Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

level1.description:
Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush.

Project a defensive field in the target direction for 3 seconds, reducing the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside it by 60%.

Damage dealt to the Mech from enemies within Defense Matrix still grants the same amount of Self-Destruct Charge.

Fusion Cannons

Whenever an Image takes damage, it deals that amount of damage to itself, effectively doubling the damage it takes.

Mirror Images last for 8 seconds, and up to 2 Mirror Images can be active at a time. Each time they or Samuro hit an enemy Hero with their Basic Attack, their duration is extended by 1 second. Using Mirror Image removes most negative effects from Samuro.

Samuro is Unrevealable for the first 1 second of Wind Walk.

Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level16.name: Master Warp-Blade
level16.description: Every third consecutive Basic Attack against the same target deals 125% more damage.

level16.name: Void Slash
level16.description: If Cleave hits more than one enemy Hero, it deals 40% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

level16.name: Sentenced to Death
level16.description: Deal 25% increased damage to enemies while they are marked or Slowed by Singularity Spike.

level20.name: Twilight Falls
level20.description: Might of the Nerazim resets the cooldown of all Basic Abilities.

level20.name: Unwavering Pressure
level20.description: Singularity Spike no longer costs Mana. Basic Attacks against enemies reduce its cooldown by 1.25 seconds, double versus Heroes.

level20.name: Shadow Stride
level20.description: Reduce the cooldown of Vorpal Blade by 10 seconds. Casting Vorpal Blade grants Zeratul a Shield that absorbs up to 260~~0.04~~ damage for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Shadow Mending
level20.description: Heal for 60% of Spell Damage dealt to Heroes.

basic.name: Grievous Throw
basic.description: Zul'jin throws an axe forward, dealing 125~~0.04~~ damage to the first 2 enemies hit and marking them for 6 seconds. Marked enemies take 50% bonus damage from Zul'jin's next 3 Basic Attacks against them.

basic.name: Twin Cleave
basic.description: Throw 2 axes in a large, circular arc, dealing 112~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing affected enemies by 15% per axe for 2 seconds.

basic.name: Regeneration
basic.description: Zul'jin channels to regenerate 30% of his maximum Health over 4 seconds. Moving while channeling or taking damage will interrupt this effect.

heroic.name: Taz'dingo!
heroic.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

heroic.name: Guillotine
heroic.description: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330~~0.04~~ damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

trait.name: Berserker
trait.description:
Activate to increase Basic Attack damage by 25% but consume 2% maximum Health per attack.

Passive: Zul'jin attacks 1% faster for every 1% of maximum Health missing.

You Want Axe?

Quest: Every 5 Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 1.

Reward: After attacking Heroes 75 times, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.

Reward: After attacking Heroes 150 times, Twin Cleave now revolves twice.

Lose 3 stacks on death.

activable.name: Amani Rage
activable.description: Activate to cause Zul'jin to instantly lose 50% of his current Health and heal for that amount over 10 seconds.

activable.name: Voodoo Shuffle
activable.description:
Activate to remove Roots and Slows.

Passive: Lower the cooldown and Mana cost of Regeneration by 40%.

activable.name: Ensnare
activable.description: Throw a net forward, Rooting the first enemy Hero hit for 1.5 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, Ensnare's cooldown is reduced to 10 seconds.

level1.name: Boneslicer
level1.description: Grievous Throw now pierces through all enemies hit and restores 15 Mana per Hero hit. Additionally, Grievous Throw's mark is no longer removed by Basic Attacks.

level1.name: Recklessness
level1.description: While Zul'jin is below 75% Health, he gains 10% Spell Power. While he is below 50% Health, his Basic Attack damage is increased by 10% and Basic Attacks against Heroes grant an additional stack of You Want Axe?.

level1.name: Headhunter
level1.description:
Quest: Zul'jin's first Takedown against each enemy Hero permanently increases his damage dealt by 2.5%.

Reward: After getting Takedowns on every enemy Hero, Basic Attack range is increased by 1.1.

level4.name: Troll's Blood
level4.description: Increase Regeneration's healing by 25%. If Regeneration fully finishes, restore 10% of Zul'jin's maximum Mana.

level4.name: Voodoo Shuffle
level4.description:
Activate to remove Roots and Slows.

Passive: Lower the cooldown and Mana cost of Regeneration by 40%.

level4.name: Amani Hide
level4.description: Lower the cooldown of Amani Rage by 10 seconds and gain 15 Armor while regenerating Health from it.

level7.name: Vicious Assault
level7.description: Increase the duration of Grievous Throw's mark by 3 seconds and its damage bonus by 45%.

level7.name: Arcanite Axes
level7.description: Quest: Twin Cleave's damage is permanently increased by 0.75 every time it hits a Hero.

level7.name: Ferocity
level7.description: Increases the Attack Speed bonus of Berserker by 40%.

level10.name: Taz'dingo!
level10.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

level10.name: Guillotine
level10.description: Zul'jin launches a massive axe into the air that drops on the targeted area, dealing 330~~0.04~~ damage plus bonus damage the lower his Health is.

level13.name: Lacerate
level13.description: Increase the Slow amount of each Twin Cleave axe by 10% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

level13.name: Eye of Zul'jin
level13.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant Zul'jin 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%.

level13.name: Ensnare
level13.description: Throw a net forward, Rooting the first enemy Hero hit for 1.5 seconds. If no Heroes are hit, Ensnare's cooldown is reduced to 10 seconds.

level16.name: No Mercy!
level16.description: Zul'jin's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes marked with Grievous Throw ignore Armor and deal an additional 2% of maximum Health as damage.

level16.name: Wrong Place Wrong Time
level16.description: If an enemy is hit by both Twin Cleave axes at the same time, they take an additional 100~~0.04~~ damage and count as 5 Hero hits for You Want Axe?.

level16.name: Let the Killing Begin
level16.description:
When Zul'jin kills an enemy, his Attack Speed is increased by 5%, up to 40%, for 12 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration.

Hero Takedowns instantly grant 40% Attack Speed.

level20.name: Amani Resilience
level20.description: Increase Taz'dingo's duration by 1 second. Upon expiring, Zul'jin heals for 50% of the damage he dealt during Taz'dingo.

level20.name: Buzzsaw
level20.description: After impact, Guillotine continues forward, dealing 75% damage to enemies hit. If a Hero is killed by Guillotine, Zul'jin is instantly healed to full.

level20.name: Forest Medicine
level20.description: Regeneration is no longer Channeled, and cannot be interrupted.

level20.name: A Surprise For Ya
level20.description: Basic Attacks bounce to a nearby enemy for 50% damage, prioritizing enemy Heroes.

commonAbilities.name: Summon Mount
commonAbilities.description: After Channeling for 1 second, gain 30% Movement Speed.

commonAbilities.name: Hearthstone
commonAbilities.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health and 150 Mana.
